_what: Per-crate ceiling on .rs files under src/ that no `mod` declaration reaches from the crate root. Measured by `tri mods orphan --gate`.
_why: #2427, a Zig-lexer PR, removed `mod elab;` from cli/tri/src/main.rs in the same hunk as two other lines and left the 319-line file. cargo build cannot error on a file it does not compile, the suite fell 358 -> 354, and no gate reads the test count. Nothing printed a word for six days (#2900).
_rule: Exact match, not an upper bound. A count BELOW its ceiling fails too, so the next orphan cannot hide in the slack -- lower the number in the commit that connects a file.
_bootstrap_7: Pre-existing, not repaired here: _enrich/mod.rs, math_pslq.rs, neural/attention.rs, neural/hslm.rs, runtime_minimal.rs, runtime_minimal_test.rs, tooling.rs. The last one holds 7 gate bodies and is #2905; the rest are unexamined. Connecting any of them is a decision about what goes red, not a repair.
_scope: Every crate in Cargo.toml `members`, read at run time. The list used to be hardcoded as bootstrap + cli/tri while the workspace named five, so three members were watched by nothing and their files were absent from the total. A guard written as a list goes stale by addition.
_bin_targets: src/bin/*.rs is a binary target cargo discovers by layout, with no `mod` line anywhere. It is a root, not an orphan -- cli/dlc10/src/bin/dlc10.rs would otherwise be a false positive.
